---
title: "NHANES Dashboard"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: rows
    vertical_layout: fill
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(pacman)

pacman::p_load(
  here,           # project-relative file paths
  rio,            # data import
  tidyverse,      # data manipulation
  knitr,          # include_graphics()
  flexdashboard   # dashboard layout, gauge() and valueBox()
)

# Full cleaned dataset, all ages. The gauge below reports the share of
# participants aged 21 and over, so the sample must not be pre-filtered.
nhanes <- import(here("data", "cleaned_NHANES.csv"))

# Average of the four systolic readings.
# NA only when all four readings are missing.
sbp_cols <- c("systolic_bp_1", "systolic_bp_2",
              "systolic_bp_3", "systolic_bp_4")

nhanes <- nhanes |>
  mutate(sbp_avg = rowMeans(across(all_of(sbp_cols)), na.rm = TRUE))
```

Row {data-height=650}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Age distribution of the NHANES sample

```{r, out.width="100%", fig.align="center"}
include_graphics(here("figures", "ex2_age.png"))
```

Row {data-height=350}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Participants aged 21 years and over

```{r}
pct_21 <- round(100 * mean(nhanes$age >= 21, na.rm = TRUE), 1)

gauge(
  pct_21,
  min = 0, max = 100, symbol = "%",
  gaugeSectors(
    success = c(67, 100),
    warning = c(34, 66),
    danger  = c(0, 33)
  )
)
```

### Average systolic blood pressure above 120 mm Hg

```{r}
pct_high <- round(100 * mean(nhanes$sbp_avg > 120, na.rm = TRUE), 1)

valueBox(
  paste0(pct_high, "%"),
  caption = "of participants with a blood pressure measurement",
  icon    = "fa-heartbeat",
  color   = "#B3322C"
)
```
